title: Mosaics your way
text: This was a great class in Mosaics, very friendly and knowledgeable le staff.    Always ready to help with gentle suggestions.
author: Kathy_S

title: Great to make a keepsake inspired by Gaudi’s work!
text: Enjoyable creating a mosaic piece that’s easy to do!
author: Sue J

title: Fun Family Activity
text: What a wonderful way to remember our holiday in Spain. We booked this class as a fun activity for our family. We are so glad we did! The staff explained the basics of making a mosaic item. They have plenty of templates that you can choose from and they provide all the tools and materials required. There is plenty of staff available to help each participant and they are very patient answering questions from those of us that are not very "artsy" or "crafty". author: goalmom10

title: Such a great class!
text: This was so fun! I booked the four hour class because some of the reviews here stated two hours was not enough. Axelle was my instructor, and she did a fantastic job making sure I knew how to properly cut and glue the tiles. I chose to make the salamander since it’s one of Gaudi’s mosaics at Park Güell, and it represents Barcelona to me. It turned out so cute. I love it! Please make note that your mosaics need time to be grouted and dried. So you’ll do the work one day and need to pick it up the following day. If you have the time to book a class here, do it! You won’t regret it.
author: Emily_M

title: Brilliant fun, recommend!!
text: It was a fun experience watching my friend trying to complete her mosaic in an hour and we needed another hour to get it done. Staff were great
author: mattnikkitrix

title: Highlight of our trip!
text: One of the highlights of our trip to Barcelona after a day visiting the beautiful Sagrada Familia! Staff was very helpful and friendly! Highly recommend.
author: staceyf727

title: Great Barcelona experience!
text: This was a great experience. We had a lot of fun making our own mosaics. The guide was very friendly and helpful. Our projects turned out great!
author: L3022WVsarahw

title: A must for creative people visiting Barcelona
text: Super fun activity for creative people. Unleash your inner artist and make mosaic. The staff were helpful and the instructions easy to understand. Cutting and placing tiles in a nice design is harder than it seems and two hours flys by.
author: KjerstiRH

title: I had a great time and...
text: I had a great time and met some other people and learned something new while creating a unique souvenir of Barcelona.
author: Mark_E

title: Fun experience
text:
The young woman who taught us was amazing.  I can not recall her name. She was very professional. Her English was so good I thought she was from the States. She was from Turkey.  She made this class very fun. 
We have cool souvenirs that we made too.
